ash.sessions.management.help: The session list shows background activity without opening conversations. Needs input, Working, Ready for review, Failed and Stopped are management states. Session History shows the state of each branch. Opening a branch preserves the other conversations and drafts.
ash.sessions.details.heading: Session details
ash.sessions.github.attachIssueTitle: Attach an issue to this session
ash.sessions.github.connectIssueHost: Connect a GitHub account for {0} before attaching this issue.
ash.sessions.github.invalidIssueUrl: Enter an HTTPS issue URL, such as https://github.com/owner/repo/issues/123.
ash.sessions.github.issueHelp: Use Attach issue to enter an HTTPS GitHub issue URL. The issues summary shows open, closed and unavailable counts. Press Enter or Space on the summary to expand its links, then use Tab to open or remove an issue. Each link includes its full title and state. Open Accessible View to read all issue states as text. Escape collapses the list and returns focus to the summary. Remove detaches the saved association without closing the issue on GitHub. Unavailable issues remain removable and are not counted as completed.

ash.sessions.changes.checkPages: Could not read all check results.
ash.sessions.changes.noRepository: No Git repository is available in this session directory.
ash.sessions.changes.repositoryChanged: The repository or branch changed. Start the operation again.
ash.sessions.changes.prRequired: Enter a title and a target branch different from the source branch.
ash.sessions.changes.prUncertain: GitHub may have created the pull request. Check the repository before trying again.

ash.sessions.changes.prChooseRemote: Choose the repository and remote for the pull request

ash.sessions.changes.prAttachFailed: The pull request was created, but could not be attached to this session.
ash.sessions.changes.prAutoFailed: The pull request was created, but auto-merge could not be enabled.
ash.sessions.changes.prHelp:
Create pull request
Use Tab and Shift+Tab to move between the title, target branch, description, Draft checkbox, merge mode and actions. Choose Create pull request to submit the displayed values. Escape or Cancel closes the form and returns focus. Changes to the session or GitHub account close the form. Creation checks the repository and branch again; a changed context requires reopening the form.
ash.sessions.changes.operationsHelp: Use Tab to reach the summary and actions. Retry loading changes reloads a failed list. Sync changes pulls and pushes the session repository; Publish branch publishes it. Review working tree opens live uncommitted changes. Create pull request opens an editable form; publish the source branch before creating the pull request. Checks shows all check runs and commit statuses for associated open pull requests. Enter or Space on Checks expands or collapses the list. Check links open the full results. Switching sessions or accounts clears old checks; hiding Changes cancels its reads.
ash.sessions.changes.prGitHubError: GitHub could not prepare or create the pull request. Check your account and repository, then reopen the form.
ash.sessions.changes.checkGitHubError: GitHub checks are unavailable. Check your account and repository access; the view will retry.
ash.sessions.changes.prHeadChanged: The published branch differs from the local commit. Review the pull request before merging.
ash.sessions.changes.prAccountsError: Could not load GitHub accounts. Reconnect GitHub and try again.
ash.sessions.changes.prNeedsBranch: Create a commit on a named branch before creating a pull request.
ash.sessions.changes.reviewHelp: Choose All Turns or a specific Turn to filter files. Switch between List and Tree; use Left and Right arrows to collapse or expand folders. Select files and choose Mark reviewed or Mark unreviewed. Read markers belong to the exact Turn revision and do not change commit eligibility. Each conversation and view mode retains its selection, focus, expansion and scroll position while this window is open.
ash.sessions.changes.prAgentUnavailable: This repository cannot prepare a pull request request for the agent.
ash.sessions.changes.prReadOnly: Cannot send a pull request request to an archived conversation.
ash.sessions.changes.prAgentDraft: Create a draft pull request and leave it in draft.
ash.sessions.changes.prAgentReady: Create a pull request ready for review.
ash.sessions.changes.prAgentContext: Use repository {0} in {1}, source branch {2}, and target branch {3}. If the repository or branch has changed, stop and ask me to review the context.
ash.sessions.changes.prAgentPublish: Review the changes, commit the intended files, and push the source branch as needed. Follow the ordinary permission and approval requirements.
ash.sessions.changes.prAgentAuto: Enable GitHub auto-merge using {0}. Wait for required checks and approvals; do not bypass them.
ash.sessions.changes.prAgentManual: Do not merge the pull request or enable auto-merge.
ash.sessions.changes.prAgentGenerate: Generate a title and description that summarize the changes.
ash.sessions.changes.prMissingChat: The initiating conversation is no longer available.
ash.sessions.changes.prSent: Pull request request submitted to the initiating conversation.
ash.sessions.changes.prAgentUncertain: The agent request could not be confirmed. Check the initiating conversation before sending it again.
ash.sessions.changes.prAgentHelp: Choose Create directly to use GitHub, or Ask agent to create to submit the displayed title, description, branch and merge choice to this conversation. An active Turn queues the request. This uses normal agent permissions. Draft and merge choices are remembered for the profile and limited by the current repository. An unconfirmed submission disables retry; inspect the conversation or repository first.
